steps.clue: Recover the truck keys in the future, then move the truck in the past.
Recover the four parts and build the Blundergat.
Collect the swing seat and chalk, then talk to the Twins.
Complete the tree, piano and toy box puzzles and beat the Twins’ three games.
Charge the Music Box, Music Sheet and Cymbals with the Sundergat.
Set the Doomsday Clock, then adjust it while teleporting to summon the Twins.
Follow the Twins through the piano, toy box and fireplace locations.
Speak to the Twins at the swing, enter the portal, then defeat the Dark Heart.
